goal:
The toolkit package in this project has twelve functions that raise NotImplementedError. Implement all of them so test_toolkit.py passes.

They are spread across toolkit/text.py, toolkit/numbers.py, toolkit/lists.py and toolkit/dates.py, three in each. Every docstring says what its function must do, and each is described more precisely by the checks in the test file.

Do not change test_toolkit.py: the checks describe the behaviour, and editing them is not an implementation. Use only the standard library.

Work module by module and re-run the test as you go, so partial progress is visible.

Verify by running: python test_toolkit.py. Report the exit code you actually saw.
